Game Overview

In Merge Puzzles Fold the Watermelon!, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a vibrant world of fruit fusion where strategic merging challenges your mind. In "Fold the Watermelon!" carefully drop and connect fruits to create magnificent combinations.
